A fragment of a small iron hand-bell plated with copper-alloy using the 'fusion-plating process' (Bourke 1980; 1983). The bell is quadrangular in plan and has a slightly domed crown. Only a fragment of the corner of the crown survives. The top contains a circular hole, perhaps representing where one end of cross-piece was inserted.
